title: Api sim command
description: The body of POST /api/sim/{cmd}. The route fills `cmd` from the path segment before it validates, so the body a client sends is the argument object and the validated document is the pair. The per-command argument definitions below are copied from control-cmd.schema.json and test/ws-api.test.ts asserts the two copies stay deep-equal: the REST body and the MQTT command the backend publishes from it must never drift apart.

command.title: Command
command.description: What the simulator is asked to do.

no_args.title: No args
no_args.description: The empty argument object of play, pause, clear_injections and reset.

speed.description: Simulated seconds per wall-clock second: 1 is real time, 3600 is one hour per second.

jump_args.title: Jump args
jump_args.description: Arguments of jump: exactly one of a ground-truth preset or a data time. Each alternative is closed, so naming both is rejected.

preset_id.description: Identifier of a replay preset offered in the ground-truth catalog.

sim_ts.description: Data time to jump to; it must lie inside the replayed dataset.

inject_args.title: Inject args
inject_args.description: Arguments of inject. Omitted parameters fall back to the values the injection declares in the ground-truth catalog.

injection_id.description: Identifier of a fault injection offered by the simulator.

params.description: Overrides for the strength and the length of the injection.

magnitude.description: Strength of the injection, in the unit the injection declares.

duration_sim_min.description: Length of the injection in simulated minutes, up to ten simulated days.

args.description: The arguments of the command; empty for the commands that take none.
